messages:
Emma_CS: Quick check-in for SolacePay — noticed an error-rate spike over the last 24h, digging into breakdown now. 5xx + timeouts + some rate-limited responses. @Sam-Eng can you grab logs and any recent deploys?
Sam-Eng: On it. I see a sharp 5xx rise starting ~02:50 UTC. Pulling traces now. Might be related to the model variant change from last night.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: prod deployment completed — model-switch to model-redwood-v2.1 at 02:58:12 UTC (user: deploy-ci).
Priya-CS: Customer said invoices are failing intermittently and they saw a few timeouts in their Sentry errors. Concerned about renewal impact this week.
Diego-SRE: Initial triage: a mix — some upstream 500s from runtime (OOM-ish traces), a bunch of 504/timeout errors coming from our edge cache hitting Redis timeouts, and a handful of 429s from burst traffic. Correlation with the model switch time window.
Emma_CS: Quick stats from last 24h (aggregated): total errors = 1,420 (baseline ~220/day). Breakdown: 5xx = 78% (1,108), timeouts (504/timeout) = 15% (213), rate-limits (429) = 7% (99). Top failing endpoints by error count: /v1/generate (65% of 5xx), /v1/embeddings (20%), /v1/chat/stream (8%), /v1/retry (7%).
Sam-Eng: Log queries I ran: ```logs query "service:inference status>=500 | group_by endpoint | count()" --last 24h``` Returned /v1/generate = 720, /v1/embeddings = 220, /v1/chat/stream = 90.
Sam-Eng: Deeper traces for /v1/generate show most failures during long-seq requests (seq_len > 1024) — memory pressure in runtime path.
Lina-Support: Customer-facing note: SolacePay is seeing payment retries fail ~6% of attempts. We should schedule a quick patch note + workaround (reduce seq_len / smaller batches) for them. @Priya-CS please coordinate.
Diego-SRE: Immediate mitigation options: 1) roll back model switch to v2.0 (lower mem), 2) throttle long-seq requests at the gateway, 3) increase replica pool / bump GPU mem allocation on Dedicated hosts. Recommend rolling back while we investigate root cause.
Sam-Eng: Agreed. Initiating rollback to model-redwood-v2.0 now. Will monitor error curve.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback triggered by Sam-Eng — model set to model-redwood-v2.0 at 03:12:05 UTC.
Diego-SRE: After rollback (03:20 UTC) error rate dipped ~70% in the first 10 minutes for /v1/generate. Redis timeouts reduced after clearing a stale cache shard (cleared at 03:05 UTC).
Emma_CS: Current status: errors trending down but not back to baseline yet. Action items: @Sam-Eng continue monitoring for 6h, @Diego-SRE follow up on memory RCA and runtime kernel choices, @Priya-CS prepare customer note and credit/compensation guidance if needed.
Priya-CS: Will draft note and send to SolacePay by EOD. Confirmed they want a post-mortem before renewal conversation next week.
Lina-Support: I'll update the internal status doc and flag renewal-risk = elevated for the account.
Sam-Eng: Adding a perf/qa task: reproduce long-seq failure locally with v2.1 and capture heap/dump. Ticket created: INF-4578.
Diego-SRE: Follow-up: check quantization path — v2.1 changed default KV cache allocation. Might need kernel tweak.
Emma_CS: Thanks everyone. We'll regroup in 3 hours for a status update. If anyone finds a smoking gun earlier, ping thread. :thumbsup:
